summary_claims.claim: Operators may not use addictive reward systems to encourage minors to engage
Operators must provide tools for minors and parents to manage privacy settings

note: No official copy is stored (Idaho's site refuses connections), so the record is level C and rests on the Transparency Coalition tracker, which supports the title, the enactment on 31 Mar 2026 and the effective date of 1 Jul 2027. A search found the Idaho Legislature's S1297 text and reports of signing on 31 Mar 2026 and Session Law Chapter 249, in line with the record; nothing newer. The extractor's request to store the Legislature's pages stands.
